title: Show more detailed network activity, like System Monitor's Download / Upload Rate history chart
line: The Networks widget's speed graph now shows the last 80 seconds of traffic as soon as you open a connection's details, instead of starting empty.
explanation: The applet computed speeds in each connection's list delegate from NetworkManager's device statistics, which it only switched on while the popup was open; the delegates and the network model are destroyed when the popup closes, so the graph always started from nothing. A new TrafficHistory object, kept alive by the applet's root item, reads the byte counters of every activated device from /sys/class/net every 2 seconds and keeps the last 40 speeds; it only builds and publishes the history to QML while the popup is open (an active property bound to expanded), so while closed it just reads two small files per device and updates a few numbers. The details graph and the speed subtitle read from it.

commits.message:
applet: keep a short speed history for the details graph

The applet only measured network speeds while its popup was open, so the
speed graph was always empty when opening a connection's details. Keep
sampling activated devices' byte counters and show that recent history.

BUG: 514435

media.caption: Before: details opened after reopening the popup, the graph only has the last few seconds
After: details opened after the popup had been closed for half a minute, the graph shows the full 80 seconds, including the time it was closed
